mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness and economic slowdown, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the correlation between UNRATE and SPX 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL>3.0% and FEDFUNDS>4.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity and corporate earnings growth, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600.0 thousand units signals housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when HOUST falls below 1600.0, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 > 11500.0), a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals overheating and potential policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (GDPC1>11500.0 and CPIAUCSL>3.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
